description: Source code implementing (2^1+,2) cuckoo hashing in jemalloc, including functions for search, insert, remove, grow, shrink, and rebuild operations, with specific focus on hash table management and collision resolution.

methods.name: ckh_bucket_search
methods.description: Search a specific bucket for a key, returning cell index or SIZE_T_MAX if not found.

methods.name: ckh_isearch
methods.description: Search the hash table for a key using primary and secondary hash functions.

methods.name: ckh_try_bucket_insert
methods.description: Attempt to insert a key-data pair into a specified bucket, returning success status.

methods.name: ckh_evict_reloc_insert
methods.description: Evict and relocate items to find space for a new key-data pair, detecting cycles.

methods.name: ckh_try_insert
methods.description: Attempt to insert a key-data pair, with eviction/relocation if necessary.

methods.name: ckh_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuild the hash table from existing entries, used during resizing.

methods.name: ckh_grow
methods.description: Increase the size of the hash table and rebuild.

methods.name: ckh_shrink
methods.description: Reduce the size of the hash table and rebuild.

methods.name: ckh_new
methods.description: Initialize a new cuckoo hash table with minimum items and hash/key comparison functions.

methods.name: ckh_delete
methods.description: Deallocate and clean up the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_count
methods.description: Return the number of items in the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_iter
methods.description: Iterate over items in the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_insert
methods.description: Insert a key-data pair into the hash table, resizing if needed.

methods.name: ckh_remove
methods.description: Remove a key from the hash table, shrinking if necessary.

methods.name: ckh_search
methods.description: Search for a key in the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_string_keycomp
methods.description: Compare two string keys for equality.

methods.name: ckh_pointer_keycomp
methods.description: Compare two pointer keys for equality.
